applicabilityBasis.summary: AUDM is an issuer-managed non-cash payment token redeemable for AUD1 by eligible onboarded holders, with reserve assets held on trust. The PDS describes payment use and a fixed monetary-value obligation; holders receive no reserve income or yield and the token is not a bank deposit.

genius.notes: Review as of 2026-10-07: issuerEntity is unchanged. Current issuer PDS and ASIC instrument support Catena Digital Pty Ltd issuance, AFSL566313 and issuer-disclosed DCE100887005-001. No issuer-specific GENIUS approval, application or registered foreign exception was found. The issuer monthly reserve verification and independent quarterly AUP are separate; monthlyAttestationPresent remains false for independent monthly attestation. Current transparency snapshot covers 30 September 2026. Former FAQ evidence was replaced because the fetched FAQ now shows questions without substantive answers. The generic AUSTRAC VASP announcement failed plain fetch, browser navigation and requests retry and was removed; issuer-specific Australian registration remains sourced to the PDS. Broad GENIUS DASP restrictions remain prospective. The current Macropod trust-and-compliance guide confirms Catena Digital as issuer. OCC Corporate Decision 1392 concerns Catena Labs and its proposed U.S. bank, a different entity, and supplies no AUDM authorization.
